evals.prompt: For Nautilus Rust 0.63.0 I need live five-minute Databento bars in an actor through a factory-backed node. Can I request ES.c.0 external bars because the direct client understands continuous symbology? Give the supported data path without making a connection.
evals.expected_output: Use qualified dated native identity and DataEngine internal aggregation over supported input; qualify node symbology and external bar limitations.
assertions: Distinguishes direct-client symbology inference from factory-backed node subscriptions that omit stype_in.
Does not promise Databento node external-live-bar support.
Uses native INTERNAL aggregation over supported trades or quotes with correct instrument metadata; does not add an application bar builder.

evals.prompt: Our Nautilus Rust data merger treats every ts_init as transport arrival. It also maps a Databento continuous future straight to an IB order instrument and treats an empty historical response as no market activity. Review the data assumptions only.
evals.expected_output: Identify source-specific timestamps, explicit dated IB qualification and empty-response ambiguity.
assertions: IB bars can set both timestamps to computed close, so ts_init is not universally receipt time.
Requires explicit dated signal-to-execution mapping including contract qualification; Databento identity is not IB conId metadata.
Empty historical response may represent a logged request error and does not establish complete empty coverage.

evals.prompt: My data is already normalized. I need a Nautilus Strategy to handle partial fills, cancellation races and bracket capital reservations. Which workflow owns it?
evals.expected_output: Choose building-nautilus-strategies and avoid redoing ingestion.
assertions: Assigns order lifecycle and capital reservations to Strategy authoring.
Does not substitute a data actor or provider ingestion adapter as the trading authority.
